description: constraints.npm: keep Renovate's lockfile updates on npm 11, the major CI and local dev use (Node 26 bundles npm 11). npm 12 fails `npm install --package-lock-only` with EALLOWREMOTE on registry tarballs when the tree has a package with bundleDependencies (Tailwind 4's @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi): npm/cli#9800. Remove once that is fixed and we move to npm 12.

Opt in to the (beta) nix manager so flake.lock updates arrive as their own PRs instead of riding along in unrelated ones. Requires nix in the Renovate runner. Lockfile maintenance is enabled only for this manager, so npm/Go lockfiles are not refreshed by it.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major npm updates into a single PR (they share package-lock.json, so separate PRs conflict).
Group all non-major Go module updates into a single PR (they share go.sum + the flake.nix goVendorHash, so separate PRs conflict).
